chunks: Know that one-fifth of what you acquire as booty (of war) is for God and His Apostle, and for relatives and orphans, the poor and wayfarers, if you truly believe in God and what We revealed to Our votary on the day of victory over the infidels when the two armies clashed (at Badr). For God has the power to do any thing.

key_terms.ذِي الْقُرْبَى: Close relatives (specifically Ahl al-Bayt in Shia exegesis)
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْفُرْقَانِ: The Day of the Criterion (Battle of Badr)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling of Khums on war booty in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This foundational verse (8:41) establishes the Khums on war booty, specifically highlighting the share of the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt, which Shia scholars interpret as a divine right of the Imams. It links this financial obligation to the believers' faith and the revelation received on the Day of Al-Furqan (Battle of Badr), serving as a key proof for the spiritual and temporal authority of the Prophet's household.
